claims: The UConn Huskies men’s basketball team has won six NCAA national championships in 1999, 2004, 2011, 2014, 2023, and 2024.
All UConn Huskies men’s basketball team NCAA national championships occurred in the last 25 years.
The UConn Huskies men’s basketball team won back-to-back NCAA national championships in 2023 and 2024, the first team to do so in 17 years.
The UConn Huskies men’s basketball team has advanced to the 2026 National Championship game.
In the 1999 NCAA national championship, UConn defeated Duke 77-74.
In the 2004 NCAA national championship, UConn defeated Georgia Tech 82-73.
In the 2011 NCAA national championship, UConn defeated Butler 53-41.
In the 2014 NCAA national championship, UConn defeated Kentucky 60-54.
In the 2023 NCAA national championship, UConn defeated San Diego State 76-59.
In the 2024 NCAA national championship, UConn defeated Purdue 75-60.
Since 1999, UConn has won six NCAA titles, twice as many as any other program in that span.
UConn became the eighth school in NCAA history to win back-to-back titles in 2024.
The 2024 UConn team became the first team since the NCAA tournament expanded to 64 teams in 1985 to win every tournament game by at least 14 points.
UConn is third all-time in NCAA championships with 6, trailing UCLA (11) and Kentucky (8).
The UConn women's basketball program has won 12 NCAA national championships.
